svg.font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: CHASE ground and aerial charging
svg.desc: A circular field around a base station is cut by azimuth into load-balanced clusters, one ground charging vehicle each. An inner disk is served by UAVs anchored at the base. One vehicle leg from its position to the most urgent request is shown with its corridor: only pending nodes inside the corridor, ahead of the vehicle and nearer than the anchor are folded in. A carried UAV is released to a peripheral node and recovered at a rendezvous on the vehicle path.
svg.text: A corridor around each ground leg, and UAVs for the periphery
anchor the most urgent node (EDF), then fold in
only the pending nodes that are
so deadline-first and nearest-first act together.
take the most peripheral requests and rejoin
the moving vehicle at a predicted rendezvous.
served by UAVs anchored at the base station.
Same geometry as Fig. 1 of the paper, with the Fig. 2 corridor rule and a Fig. 3 UAV mission drawn on one leg; restyled for the site.
